p: Gilgal: Which was the place where the children of Israel were circumcised after they came over Jordan and had been forty years in the wilderness, Jos 5:9.
sons of the prophets that were: So called, because they are begotten anew as it were by the heavenly doctrine.
thy head to day: That is, from being your head any more: for to be as the head, is to be the master, as to be at the feet, is to be a scholar.
know it: For the Lord had revealed it to him.
Jericho came to Elisha: Not only at Bethel, but at Jericho and other places were there prophets, who had scholars, whom they instructed and brought up in the true fear of God.

let a double portion of thy: Let your spirit have double force in me, because of these dangerous times: or let me have twice as much as the rest of the prophets: or if your spirit were to be divided into three parts, let me have two.
heaven: Thus God has left a testimony in all ages (both before the law, in the law and in the gospel).
spirit of Elijah doth rest on: The Spirit of prophecy was given to him as it was to Elijah.
Ye shall not send: Because the fact was extraordinary, they doubted where he had gone, but Elisha was assured that he was taken up to God.
the salt in there: Thus God gave him power, even contrary to nature, to make the water profitable for man's use, which before was hurtful.
cursed them in the name of: Perceiving their malicious heart against the Lord and his word, he asks God to avenge the injury done to him.
